locations.name: The Crooked Lantern
locations.summary: Rain drums on a crooked roof; warm light spills across the threshold.

locations.name: Common room
locations.summary: A worn red rug divides crowded tables from the hearth and bar.

locations.name: Behind the bar
locations.summary: Bottles crowd the shelves; Brann guards the narrow passage at the counter’s end.

locations.name: Bard’s stage
locations.summary: Scuffed planks amplify every missed note.

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.summary: Onion steam hangs above old ale stock and a shut cellar hatch.

locations.name: Stairs
locations.summary: Two worn steps lead toward rooms beyond this episode’s map.

locations.name: Hearthside
locations.summary: A loose brick sits within reach of the fire’s warmth.

locations.name: Cellar hatch and old stock
locations.summary: Dust cakes the barrels beside a heavy wooden hatch.

characters.name: Kael Varn
characters.summary: Half-elf ranger, level 5; a tracker following a forger’s last trail.
characters.personality: Quiet, watchful; asks short questions and remembers the answers.
characters.background: Odo forged the warrant that ruined Kael’s family. The Inkless Quill may expose the hand behind it. At Greywater, Kael carried Mael out of a burning chapel.
characters.appearance: Rain-dark green cloak, auburn hair, a yew bow over one shoulder.

characters.name: Ilsa Quickfingers
characters.summary: Halfling rogue, level 5; every smile hides an exit.
characters.personality: Warm teasing patter; counts pockets while appearing to count friends.
characters.background: A Thieves’ Guild courier who lost a crooked card game to Brann. She needs the debt erased before the guild hears.
characters.appearance: Violet coat, black curls, quick hands below the table.

characters.name: Doran Ashby
characters.summary: Human fighter, level 5; a patient man with one dangerous grudge.
characters.personality: Plain-spoken and protective; falls silent at talk of his brother.
characters.background: His brother died in an Ashen Hand ambush. Doran has followed the faction’s burned-hand seal from town to town.
characters.appearance: Copper hair, dented mail, shield painted with a faded ash tree.

characters.name: Sister Mael
characters.summary: Human cleric, level 5; mercy sits uneasily beside obedience.
characters.personality: Gentle, measured speech; touches her holy symbol before a difficult answer.
characters.background: Kael saved her at Greywater. Her abbess now demands the quill for the Temple of the Dawn, by any means.
characters.appearance: Ivory robes over mail, white veil, a small gold sun at her throat.

characters.name: Brann, the barkeep
characters.summary: Keeper of the Crooked Lantern, its keys and its grudges.
characters.personality: Gruff hospitality; polishes the same mug when nervous.
characters.background: Bought the Lantern’s trade from Odo and inherited more debts than customers. Keeps Odo’s small iron key on his belt.
characters.appearance: Broad shoulders, rolled sleeves, flour-white apron stained with ale.

characters.name: Old Tobb
characters.summary: A drunk regular with scraps of a useful memory.
characters.personality: Wandering sentences, startling flashes of clarity, then another drink.
characters.background: Once unloaded Odo’s carts. Remembers a black feather, an old barrel and a promise not to look.
characters.appearance: Weathered face, grey wisps of hair, patched brown coat.

characters.name: Wren the bard
characters.summary: A bright voice with a weakness for a better story.
characters.personality: Rhymes when nervous; tells rumours as if they happened yesterday.
characters.background: Travels the river taverns collecting songs. Mistook the stranger’s familiar gait for Odo’s return.
characters.appearance: Crimson doublet, golden curls, a battered lute.

characters.name: Hooded stranger
characters.summary: An Ashen Hand agent waiting for someone else to find the quill.
characters.personality: Soft, precise questions; never takes off his gloves in company.
characters.background: Sent by the Ashen Hand to recover Odo’s tool and silence anyone who understands its history.
characters.appearance: Charcoal hood, grey gloves, a hard glint of metal beneath one cuff.

characters.name: Marta the cook
characters.summary: The kitchen’s ruler; very little escapes her notice.
characters.personality: Brisk and practical; dislikes wasted food and evasive answers.
characters.background: Has cooked here longer than either landlord. Odo’s forbidden old barrel has irritated her for months.
characters.appearance: Flour on her sleeves, red kerchief, a wooden spoon tucked into her apron.

attitudes.reason: Her quick hands have saved the party.
A dependable shield at his back.
Easy to tease, hard to shake.
Worries about sermons and hidden orders.
Respects her courage, doubts her schemes.
She tended his wounds without questions.
Shares his loyalty, fears his anger.
